summary: Comprehensive first-pass testing of Solix Technologies rebuild (backend + frontend). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass (health, submissions CRUD + validation for all 6 types, chat SSE streaming, multi-turn context, history, delete). Frontend: All 12 primary routes render with expected data-testids, no console errors. Contact demo form, contact-mode toggle, product deep-link preselect, newsletter footer, careers apply (role='Senior Platform Engineer'), partners form, gated resource download (title captured), non-gated resource preview, resource filters/search/empty-state, hero CTAs, navbar mega panels (5/5) + mega-link nav, mobile hamburger + accordion nav, AI chat widget (open, streaming deltas grow to final response, multi-turn follow-up answered, reset clears bubbles), ai-section-try-chat home button opens chat panel — all verified working end-to-end with data persisted in MongoDB.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py chat_stream: broad `except Exception` swallows exc without logging traceback context to user, but has logger.exception — OK. Consider yielding structured error on failure before returning.
Chat model tuple ('openai','gpt-5.4-mini') is hard-coded; consider env-driven for easier ops swaps.
server.py mixes `on_event('startup')` (deprecated in FastAPI ≥0.109); prefer lifespan handler.
HISTORY_LIMIT=24 combined with sending full history to LlmChat may cause growing token cost per turn; consider summarization or trimming with awareness of role pairing.
Frontend resource filter buttons lack aria-pressed state; would improve a11y and enable easier test assertions.
seed_data_creation: Test submissions created with TEST_ prefix emails across all 6 types; test chat sessions created and then deleted. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_solix_api.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/test_solix_api.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Chat stream test asserts SSE deltas + done event; allow 45s per LLM call. Frontend uses Radix Select for lead-interest — click the trigger then click any `[data-testid^="lead-interest-option-"]` option. For resource-card-2 (non-gated), first clear the filter/search state — my earlier run left whitepaper filter active which hid card 2 (not a bug).
